Finding F-007: potential underbilling on contract C-2017, SKU HTC-2002 (Coralstone Data Inc). Root cause: the contractual annual price escalation was never applied in billing.

Basis: Clause A.2 (page 3) sets the base price at USD 2,740.25 per unit. Clause 4.2 (page 1) provides for annual CPI-U-based revisions from July 1, 2024, with a 1.5% minimum and 4% maximum.

Impact: 18 invoice lines, 2024-07-05 to 2025-12-05. Potential underbilling is USD 30,474.29; estimated recoverable amount is USD 28,097.30. Latest billed unit price is USD 2,740.25 versus expected USD 2,915.59.

Requested actions (owner: Pricing & Billing Master Data): load the escalated Unit Price into the billing price master from 2024-07-05, and prepare a supplementary invoice for the under-billed lines for approval."}
